company.shortDescription: Gametime sells last-minute tickets to the most popular events in sports, music, and theater.
company.description:
Gametime sells last-minute tickets to the most popular events in sports, music, and theater. It makes finding the perfect live experience remarkably fast and easy. They curate an epic list of the most amazing possibilities in the city has to offer. Once the client selects their event it will examine over 10,000 potential seats and present them with the 50 best values to select.

Each curated seat option includes a panoramic high-resolution photo so their client can experience the actual view from their section. Navigate to the seat map to see price versus the location comparisons with true-to-life, full-color venue maps. Gametime delivers the tickets directly to the client's phone. 

Now they are offering sports, concerts, and theater events across the United States and Canada.
